title: DynaDFlash: Dynamic Feature Projection for Block Diffusion Speculators
abstract: arXiv:2611.19085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.

translated_title: DynaDFlash：面向块扩散推测解码器的动态特征投影
translated_abstract: DFlash 在其目标模型的隐藏特征上训练一个并行的草稿模型。受先前工作 DFlare 的启发——该工作引入了目标模型隐藏状态的逐层组合——我们测试了对这些状态进行依赖上下文的加权是否有助于提高块扩散推测解码器的接受长度。我们为块大小为 16 的 Qwen 3 训练了 DFlash 基线模型，并训练了一个为每一层计算门控以影响投影前隐藏特征幅度的动态模型。尽管动态模型与 DFlash 基线之间的平均接受长度没有显著差异，我们注意到动态模型在数学领域的草稿生成中表现突出。在对来自 MetaMathQA 和 Orca-Math 数据集的 700 个提示的评估中，平均接受长度提高了 5%。我们还发现，在推测解码场景下，这使同一数据集一个子集的吞吐量提高了 4.1%。
tldr: 该论文提出 DynaDFlash，通过为每层隐藏状态计算上下文相关的动态门控权重来改进块扩散推测解码的草稿模型，虽整体接受长度与基线相当，但在数学任务上平均接受长度提升 5%、吞吐量提升 4.1%。
